face_shadow_rule: CB 2026-11-15: the template drawn face shadow STAYS (face_shadow true); only generated shade is removed (card_shade amount 0, rim 0, hat_shadow 0, no far light).
_note: character-artist 2026-11-16 (fake-surgery, phase A). Copy these keys into every film.json that uses this cast. puppet_pkg paths are relative to the film.json: first episodes/fake-surgery/cast (holds sheets/surgery.mjs), then the kit code. Height = ground to the top of the bare head; caps stand above it. Puppet names cast:surgery/<name>. faces_ep goes into film.json as "faces_ep" (kit episode faces, used as face 'k:<name>'). heads_tall is written by cast/tools/render_cast.mjs.

face_presets.surgeon: masked: k:smileEyes (eyes smile over the mask; brows act), k:concentrate on the cut; never a mouth face while masked
face_presets.nurse: k:browUp (one eyebrow up, the mocker), k:skeptical; arms folded
face_presets.patient: k:drowsy (OR, half lids), k:thumbsSmile (row 10), k:wince (pre-op / gurney), standard pre-op
face_presets.boy: k:wail (eyes cry + tears + big frown; the kit's open wail mouth has a pink-red inside #c94a5f that fails the red gate), k:cheer (row 44)
face_presets.grandkid: k:cheer (arms up on the shoulders, row 50)

surgeon.scalpel: small 3D prop (sets/hero_props.js), RIGHT fist (grips kind tool), tip ON the knee's near side via held3d tip_at; never a close-up
surgeon.bulb: grey-blue rubber bulb #6a86a0, RIGHT fist (kind small), nozzle aimed at the knee; water fan from the props pack
surgeon.plaster: cream plaster, RIGHT fist pinched as a round fist on the strip end; pats with the fist
surgeon.jug: steel jug, RIGHT fist on the handle (kind handles), pour toward the bowl
surgeon.envelope: sealed envelope, RIGHT fist (kind edge), goes into the chest pocket
surgeon.coffee_cup: office mug, RIGHT fist (kind handles), settable fill
surgeon.pen: the drawn pen in the chest pocket stays drawn; a 3D pen only when he writes (RIGHT fist, kind tool)
surgeon.file_cards: card stack in both fists (kind two-hand/edge) or one card in the RIGHT fist
surgeon.ruler: steel ruler, RIGHT fist (kind tool) laid on the chart

nurse.tray: clean instrument tray flat on her LEFT fist (kind tray) or both fists at the edges (kind edge)
nurse.clipboard: consent clipboard, LEFT fist (kind edge), pen in the RIGHT

patient.cane: wooden cane, RIGHT fist on the crook (kind pole, fist on top of the shaft), tip on the floor; gone from row 33 (cobweb + spider version in the props pack)
patient.pen: signs the form with the RIGHT fist (kind tool), clipboard on the LEFT forearm
patient.clipboard: consent clipboard on the LEFT fist (kind edge)

climber1.wristband: steel-blue #5a7a9a 3D ring on the RIGHT wrist (limbs stay one colour; the band is a prop, the scraper-tray colour)

climber2.wristband: aqua #3fc2c8 3D ring on the RIGHT wrist (rinse-tray colour)

climber3.wristband: purple #7a4aa8 3D ring on the RIGHT wrist (trick-tray colour)

held_props.colleague: NO PUPPET: row 16 is a hand only, a set-drawn arm from the frame edge with sets/soft_arm.js (one slight curve, round black fist), green scrub sleeve colour #2f7d55 not needed (limbs are ink)

recline.move: m:../../ep_surgery/pt_recline | pt_thumbs | pt_smile (episode moves; card turned back 55 deg about the hip = 35 deg above the pad)
recline.act: pos [x, y, PAD_TOP_Z] on the table pad under his hips; dir so the head is toward the raised head section; view comes from the move (3/4)
recline.faces: k:drowsy at rest, k:thumbsSmile on row 10, k:wince never on the table (sedated, calm)

card_shade_rule: CB 2026-11-15: card_shade.amount 0 AND rim_amount 0 in every place, no far light, lights []. Never raise amount.
_face_note: Faces clean white; the OR lamp, the amber desk lamp and the coral evening sun show on costume, props and set, never as a band on a face. No red in any costume (the pain dial and bars are the ONE red).
_mouth_note: Red gate: the template's OPEN mouths smile, smileXL, grinXL, gasp, gaspXL, wail, shout have a pink-red inside #c94a5f (hue 350, within 12 deg of the film's red). Use red-free mouths (lens, smileSmall, teeth, proud, frownXL, wavy, flatXL, smirkXL) or ask the lead for a mouth-interior exemption. Lip-sync visemes: check per take with the red count.
